title: Garden and Postcard
author: Elodie Brightwater
blurb: Sebastian Halloran, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
